links.outcome: Landmark detection failure rate and asymmetry index differences across seven race groups
links.effect: Detection succeeded on 90.13% of images; failure ranged 5.87% (Southeast Asian) to 12.71% (White). Asymmetry group differences were statistically detectable but small (H(6)=35.37, p=3.66×10^-6, ε²≈0.003).
links.quote: Detection succeeded on 90.13% of images, but the failure rate was uneven across groups, ranging from 5.87% for Southeast Asian faces to 12.71% for White faces, which inverts the direction of skew commonly assumed for face-mesh detectors.

screen.reason: Evaluates the fairness, failure modes, and baseline asymmetry index across diverse demographic phenotypes on the FairFace benchmark dataset for a Bell's palsy assessment pipeline, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
